title: State-issue marker, region, events and kinds of state
description: Formal shape of state-issues.yaml — the marker that tells a state issue (DEC-058), the region of its description the seam rewrites, the event types its log holds, and the kinds of state that live in one, each with the record that adds it, what its key names, how a reader finds it and who may release it by force. `scripts/_lib/state_issues.py` reads and writes every state issue (ADR-071). Companion per COR-018 / the .pkit/schemas/ area conventions.

fields.description: The fields the marker names, in the order it writes them.

begin.description: The line that opens the region the seam rewrites.

events.description: The event types a state issue's log holds, as the audit-log facility declares them.

kinds.description: Kinds of state. Keys are the marker's `kind` values; values match $defs.entry.

kind_ref.description: Narrowed cross-schema reference token (COR-019) pointing at a kind of state in `state-issues.yaml`.

decided_by.description: The accepted record that adds this piece of state.

key.description: What the key of a state issue of this kind names.

found_by.description: How a reader finds the state issue: by a number configuration records, or by its marker through the one read of issues.

force_release.description: Who may release the state by force.

lapses.description: Whether a claim on the state lapses on its own.

entry.description: One kind of state that lives in state issues.
